system.description:
A Hobgoblin is what happens when a lady Troll manages to get a Goblin drunk enough to talk herself into his pants. While that description makes them sound like they come from bawdy Earth Bards, this alien Race of explosive hooligans is a plague among the stars. Large, muscular, and smart, Hobgoblins excel at trapmaking, explosives management, and all-out mayhem. Unfortunately, these guys are so ugly that even Gorgons lose their lunch looking upon them, and they've suffered a few nerfs in the most recent balancing patch. This Race is best suited for Rogue and Fighter-based Classes.

Prerequisites: This limited Race is only available to crawlers who have Rank 5+ in the Explosives Handling Skill and any Trap-based Skill

  • Size: Medium (4)
  • +1 Dexterity
  • -5 Charisma. Charisma is capped at 10
  • +3 in all Trap-based and Explosive-based Skills
  • +1 Regeneration Skill
  • Free access to all Hobgoblin Sapper Workshops
  • At the end of each floor, roll one Explosive or Trap-based Skill Advancement Check with Advantage
  • All explosives and trap-making Skills can be raised to Rank 20
  • +1 Popularity when you kill an enemy with a trap or explosive once per scene
